scope: Sanitized summaries from all 17 locally retained performance-check sessions with analysis.json, plus selected fixture/provenance records; not complete raw traces. Human screen boundaries/cache states differ. Historical candidate provenance describes that candidate at its test time. Raw traces retained locally.

performance_limits: Host presents are queued presentations, not physical scanout timestamps.
New-output cadence observes guest-output sequence changes at host presents, not simulation or audio clocks.
Gap statistics may include an interval crossing a five-second window boundary.
CPU percentage comes from ps; 100% corresponds to one logical CPU and is not a wall-stack sample percentage.
Guest CSV records GPU guest-swap intervals; it has no per-row wall timestamp and may lose buffered rows on hard exit.
The Info/loading boundary was not timestamped; its exact position on the timeline is unknown.
No audio submission, silence-insertion, queue latency or callback-duration measurement was captured.
Profiling and timing overhead have not been calibrated; frame readback was disabled.

runtime_limits: Silence includes expected startup/paused periods; phase markers are needed to diagnose audible starvation.
Repeated PCM fingerprints can reflect intentional silence or looping; they do not prove stale music.
Audio block counters refer to the 48 kHz guest stream, not physical speaker latency.
Counters are cumulative; reporting snapshots are not a transaction across audio threads.
First per-client rate window may include time before that driver was registered.
Stage durations can overlap on concurrent threads; summed duration is not elapsed stall time.
The stage event queue is bounded; dropped_events reports missing event detail while totals remain available.
Stage probes cover guest shader translation/module creation and the principal graphics pipeline creation path.
No simulation speed or end-to-end input latency is measured by these probes.

frame_limits: GPU timestamps are durations in the GPU clock domain; they are not mapped to host clock timestamps.
Completion markers are host observations, potentially later than actual GPU completion.
VdSwap writes a swap packet; written-to-processed includes later guest submission and prior command work.
Swap packet addresses are matched FIFO per physical address; unmatched or lost markers limit attribution.
Output publication and queued host presentation are not physical scanout or input latency.
Operations nest and run concurrently: do not add their wall/CPU totals to estimate a frame.
Frequent operation detail below 1 ms is filtered; aggregate counters still include every operation.
DurationScope result 0 means scope completion; it is not an operation success result.
Thread CPU deltas omit work before first/after last observation and threads that exited between reports.
Reporter queries live counters without stopping threads; profiling overhead requires off/on comparison.
